sourceFindings.title: Record real cancellation and lease phases separately from Task cancellation and later UI cleanup
sourceEvidence: BackupOperationControl.checkCancellation snapshots private cancelled then throws if cancelled OR Task.isCancelled. A CancellationError or checkCancellation result alone does not identify which cause fired.

HealthRecoveryOriginReviewLease.finish first calls control.checkCancellation, then checks actual capturing/pending identity under holder lock. A cancelled control can reject before any closed-phase guard is evaluated.

View onDisappear calls session.suspendOriginCapture then captureWork.cancel. Holder suspend can change capturing→initial and cancel matching control; BackupView clearPreview later closes review→closed. Exact ordering must be observed, not merged into one Back flag.

Operational capture error is followed by view catch calling suspendOriginCapture, which cancels control and returns lease to initial; observing cancellation only afterward would misattribute actual root-invalid error.
sourceFindings.requiredContract: Require real lock-protected control cancellation state (or exact matching cancel event plus real bit), actual worker Task.isCancelled, actual origins.state, control/session/run/nonce identity at held, Back-before-release, terminal, failure and retry boundaries. Record original error type/domain/code and execution phase before UI suspend changes cancellation; compare actual metadata availability/ready/acquire events. Record lease state transitions, not a fabricated ready/closed boolean. Use a read-only DEBUG observation accessor/dedicated noninterfering event, not replacement of the existing single cancellationHandler merely to observe it.
sourceFindings.lateReturnAttribution: Host may release the exact after-read barrier only after actual Back/owner closure and matching control cancellation are observed. Intentional barrier wait may permit cancelled worker to reach the unchanged finish call; cancellation rejection does not prove deeper phaseguard execution. If Task is also cancelled report both, not control-only attribution.
sourceFindings.terminalLifetime: Distinguish finish rejection, function/worker completion after input lifetime defer, UI wrapper completion and eventual workspace retirement. A terminal catch event still inside captureOrigins does not itself prove worker-owned input released.
sourceFindings.closure: OPEN contract wording; future concrete hook/source review required.

sourceFindings.title: Specify the two-step namespace fault and phase-specific guarded restoration
sourceEvidence: Host fault requires rename(currentroot,movedroot), then exclusive create(sentinel at original root). Each operation may be atomic individually; the pair is not one atomic replacement.

A failure after rename and before exclusive sentinel creation leaves original root absent; a competing caller could instead create a different original path. Existing exact-sentinel-only restoration wording does not explicitly cover the root-absent intermediate boundary.

LocalStore.captureLegacyRecoveryReview intentionally uses raw storageRoot and read-only rootIdentity, but unrelated checkedDirectory callers can create/restore during this artificial fault; quietstate is an observed bounded assumption, not global exclusion.
sourceFindings.requiredContract: Before each mutation persist nonce/owned exact root+parent identity, complete before current/prior/default/provider facts and intended paths. Record moved-root exact identity/tree after rename, then exact O_EXCL no-follow regular sentinel facts after creation. Define finally restoration for (a) exact owned sentinel present: remove only that sentinel then restore exact moved root into absent original; (b) root absent after owned rename but sentinel never created: restore only exact still-owned moved root; (c) any foreign/replaced/changed original or moved path: do not overwrite/delete, retain failed case and restoration error/needed owner action. Never claim restoration merely because finally ran. Keep exact namespace operation outcome before assertions/releases.
sourceFindings.metadata: Preserve full file bytes/metadata and directory inventory; distinguish expected namespace/root-parent ctime/mtime effects of rename/create/remove from immutable original file identities, rather than claiming all namespace metadata never changes.
sourceFindings.hostRelease: Before permitting capture read, independently verify exact moved tree/prior/default/provider and sentinel. Before retry verify exact restored original root inode/files/metadata, moved path absent, no unknown artifacts; no reset/checkedDirectory fallback.
sourceFindings.closure: OPEN explicit fault-transition/restoration wording; no current product mutation inferred.

pendingBack: Real captureOrigins acquires an actual RecoveryInput through BackupReviewLease, retains it through defer and performs real LocalStore capture before origins.finish. After-read barrier can hold actual local snapshot without publishing raw data to State or hook JSON.

Place hook only after LocalStore.captureLegacyRecoveryReview returns, before unchanged origins.finish. LocalStore writes.read and HealthRecoveryCopies.serialized locks have then unwound. Parent/input/worker/review ownership may legitimately retain workspaces until completion; zero-root assertions only at declared final cleanup.

Actual progress delayed300ms and metadata nil before ready naturally disable target selection/action; UI screenshots/AX should establish requested groups independently, not invent a forced state. Fresh original selection must create distinct source/review ownership after old worker terminal; no universal timing-window claim.
operationalRetry: Before-read hook after real input acquire and before LocalStore capture runs outside source-lease/store/copies locks. Real captureReview.checkCancellation then rootIdentity.lstat rejects S_IFREG as HealthLocalFiles.Failure.invalid, without checkedDirectory/migration/create/restore.

View non-cancellation catch suspends origin capture and sets actual captureIssue while active/same control/not Taskcancelled; Check again clears issue and invokes actual startOriginCapture. Deferred control cleanup must have completed before retry; new control same owner runs one-shot real capture to ready.

HealthStore.localHealthAvailable uses existing in-memory boundary/unavailable set, not a root-opening getter; this supports controlled UI during fault but does not rule out unrelated background callers.
Retry-ready only means real snapshot accepted/off choices/error absent. No recovery transaction, receipt, preservation-copy, Health-write or success acceptance is part of this proposed test.

lockAndInstrumentationRequirements: Never wait under BackupStorageRevision nonrecursive read lock, HealthRecoveryCopies serialized lock, review lease or bridge lock. Acquire/release small metadata lock only for bounded checkpoint records; no lock reentry via LocalStore revision/write in observer.

Run after-read barrier outside read locks and before real finish; before-read barrier outside locks before LocalStore read. Do not insert a test wait into strict defaults getter or inside captureReview.

Dedicated flags require DEBUG+simulator+all existing synthetic reset/backup/empty/nonmixedData guards and exact known device/source/run. Barrier scope one matching owner/control/nonce/ordinal, exact single release, actual bounded timeout/terminal failure. No global permit/auto-pass/fake rawgetter or snapshot/eligibility return.

Hook records actual metadata only: state/domain set/identity/error/task/control facts, never raw ReviewSnapshot/defaults payload/unrelated preferences. Host protected known fixedData/raw source/provider/current/prior proof stays separate and bounded.

Initial/final observation/checkpoint files must be fresh per run and raw partial observations persisted before assertions. Scope failed helper separately; retain original manifests/peers independently.

declaredEvidence.captureRule: Whole actual requested row groups/frame/bounds, not full Form. No screenshot or count credited until produced/opened. Pending controls and progress may be separate six-frame sequences.
declaredEvidence.stateProof: Full source/provider/current10/prior10/fixedData/metadata/directory inventory before/held/Back/terminal/restored/retry/final; no receipt/privatecopy/stage/Health-write expected. Actual final source/workspace cleanup no host deletion.
declaredEvidence.parentBoundary: Actual parent may retain source while worker held; source/input FD/lifetime and origin-review closure must be independently reported. Final absence cannot be imposed before legitimate owners release.

optionalDecision: Confirmation/Not now in failureRetry is explicitly optional and unnecessary for this first capture-state scope; if added, predeclare its own evidence rather than borrowing successful recovery coverage.
limits: No implementation/source-ready/runtime/product/score acceptance, no current217 native regression or Release execution credit from this contract review.

Two synthetic legacyJSON/nonmixedData/mainlightstandard cases only; no encrypted input, mixed dictionary, all Task timing windows, permissions, root replacement races or transaction recovery acceptance.
No deeper finish phaseguard claim if cancellation throws first. No true global quietstate or cross-process lock guarantee from in-process writes.read.
